name: pstack-extras
description: Skills that complement pstack. Pinned sources are cursor-team-kit, superpowers, mattpocock/skills, addyosmani/agent-skills, vercel-labs/agent-skills, and supabase/agent-skills. Original skills are build-auto, committed-browser-proof, local-supabase, legacy-critique, prd, merge-reviews, and greenfield. greenfield runs the path from an old repo to build-auto. poteto-mode remains the entry point. Codex loads these skills from ./skills/.

interface.shortDescription: Extra skills that complement pstack, including greenfield, prd, and legacy-critique
interface.longDescription: pstack-extras adds skills pstack does not ship. Vendored skills come from cursor-team-kit, superpowers, mattpocock/skills, addyosmani/agent-skills, vercel-labs/agent-skills, and supabase/agent-skills. Original skills cover a greenfield path from an old repo through legacy-critique, merge-reviews, and prd into build-auto. poteto-mode stays the entry point. Codex loads the shared skills directory.
